name: Asaatthi
publisher: Onyx Path Publishing and Nocturnal Media
heading: Asaatth Racial Traits
sourceDistinctions: The contents use Asaatthi for the people and the trait heading uses singular Asaatth. This follows the approved species key Asaatthi.
Kethsar uses the 2016 player traits. His blade and bite are separate attack choices, and the build uses no venom effect.
Fighter 2 and the Soldier background supply the class and background proficiencies.

name: Hollow Legionnaire
publisher: Onyx Path Publishing and Nocturnal Media
heading: Hollow Legionnaire Racial Traits
sourceDistinctions: The bound suit is proficient starting chain mail chosen through the Fighter class. Spirit matter and inherited armor pattern are appearance details on p. 30.
Past-Life Knowledge expands the fighter’s class skill choices to Arcana and does not grant a third class skill.
The NPC uses Humanoid as the book specifies. The Soldier background supplies Athletics and Intimidation.

name: Ironbred
publisher: Onyx Path Publishing and Nocturnal Media
heading: Ironbred Racial Traits
sourceDistinctions: Ironbred are the Redeemed branch of the sutak. The source distinguishes them from the unredeemed sutak despite their shared descent and language.
The NPC uses Fire Born for hot travel and Tough Hide at every level. Horse legs are descriptive, with no mounted movement or additional walking speed.
The Outlander supplies Survival and an additional language. Its duplicate Athletics proficiency is replaced with Nature using the 2014 background rule.

name: Manticora
publisher: Onyx Path Publishing and Nocturnal Media
heading: Manticora Racial Traits
sourceDistinctions: The Manticora is the humanoid lionfolk player species.
The source gives 40 ft. all-fours movement with both hands empty. The example conservatively treats a worn claw gauntlet as an occupied hand and can start with it stowed.
The claw gauntlet’s damage die and properties are in the Chapter Seven weapons table. The Soldier background supplies Athletics and Intimidation.

name: Slitherin
publisher: Onyx Path Publishing and Nocturnal Media
heading: Slitherin Racial Traits
sourceDistinctions: The 2016 player rules give a single Medium Slitherin profile and a Dexterity or Intelligence choice. The NPC selects Dexterity.
Veshki uses the printed finesse bite with 1d3 piercing damage, a climb speed equal to walking speed, and only the Dexterity checks covered by Contortionist.
The 2014 Urchin background duplicates Stealth and thieves’ tools. Replace those with Investigation and cobbler’s tools under the duplicate proficiency rule.
